popCulture.title: Calchas
popCulture.description: Thestor's son who read Artemis at Aulis and every omen at Troy — doomed to die when he meets a wiser seer.

popCulture.title: Mopsus
popCulture.description: Apollo and Manto's son who bests Calchas at Colophon — the contest of fig trees and pregnant sows that ends the Achaean seer's career.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer's Calchas names Agamemnon's offence against Chryses — the prophet whose Trojan omens make his Colophon death the cycle's bitter afterword.
